purpose: actual omitted operation_id and package_path schema/default test with deliberately invalid name; must reject before mutation

schema.description:
Create a Blueprint without overwriting, explicit compile, or save. Parent must resolve; known MCP/editor-tool parent chains are rejected.

        Args:
            name: New asset name. Use a single identifier, not a path.
            parent_class: Native class name (Actor/Pawn etc.) or full native/generated class path; empty means Actor.
            package_path: Directory under /Game; defaults to /Game/Blueprints (explicit empty also uses that legacy default). No object suffix.
            operation_id: Unique request ID for durable replay protection. Omitted/null generates an ID returned in the result. Reuse only with identical arguments.

        Returns:
            Structured result. data_json includes name, path, asset_path and actual parent; creation remains unsaved.
schema.name: cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.toolsets.CubelessBlueprintTools.create_blueprint

data_json.description: JSON object containing operation-specific output and legacy contract fields.

retry_json.description: JSON object describing retry policy, duplicate risk and request replay.

validation_json.description: JSON object describing performed checks and missing validation, including reload.

save_json.description: JSON object describing requested/attempted save and saved state.

compile_json.description: JSON object describing requested/attempted compile, status and diagnostics.

changes_json.description: JSON array of attempted and observed changes; no atomic rollback.

result.error: name must be a nonempty single asset identifier without path/object separators

retry.policy: Inspect the recorded result before issuing another mutation.
